1.t: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you

2.t: Until ye come to the graves.

3.t: Nay, but ye will come to know!

4.t: Nay, but ye will come to know!

5.t: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!

7.t: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.

8.t: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
